text: link_repo takes share (percent) like child links, and register_linked_repo takes a local display name
description:
OBSERVED 2026-11-23 in Felix's life graph: link_repo defaults to weight 1, but the siblings under 'commons-hub' had rescaled weights around 9, so two repo links landed at 0.8% each and a new child idea at 1%. update_idea/create_idea answer with the parent's split in percent and accept share; link_repo does neither, so the agent had to guess raw weights (re-linked with weight 8/4). Also: a linked repo's name comes from the other graph's meta name, which gave unclear labels in the life graph: 'ideas' (commons-hub/ideas), 'pong' (laser tests), 'v3' (repeer). Renaming the other graph isn't always right.

Proposal: link_repo accepts share (percent, same semantics as child links) and replies with the parent's split including repo edges. register_linked_repo (and the settings UI) accepts an optional local display name stored in the portable linkedRepos entry, falling back to the target's meta name.

Refuted if repo edges are rarely mixed with idea children.

status.comment: Accepted by Felix ('can we work on them?'). link_repo takes share (percent, same semantics as a child link's share: children and repos not named keep their proportions). It checks the share against the idea with the link in place before writing anything, and replies with the idea's split, now showing repo links by name ('40% → repo Will repo (id)'). Shares on update_idea can name a linked repo too (applyShares). Local display name: backend linkedRepo.register takes an optional name, and a new linkedRepo.rename (a write mutation in access.ts). A name this graph gave a link stays on re-registering or re-linking by host. MCP register_linked_repo takes name, and with repoId + name alone it renames. No UI form: renaming goes through the agent, as in the config philosophy. Evidence: backend linked-repos + auth tests 67/67, MCP suite 74/74 including the new 'link_repo takes a share in percent…' test, backend and mcp tsc clean.
